style: Flat 2D side elevation illustration from a children's picture book about boats and the sea. {subject}, seen exactly from the side, the whole thing visible, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, sturdy slightly chunky proportions, many small details such as portholes, railings, ropes, lights and ladders. No green anywhere on the subject. Unbranded, no logos, no text, no letters, no numbers, no water, no waves, no shadow, no scenery.
